report_contract: current authoritative release title and changes when available
source_behavior.success_rule: success is shown only after navigator.clipboard.writeText resolves
source_behavior.failure_rule: clipboard rejection or an unavailable Clipboard API produces a truthful failure and no success state
source_behavior.retry_rule: the failed copy can be retried
source_behavior.concurrency_rule: copy and retry are disabled while a clipboard write is in flight

laravel_adaptation.payload_rule: the browser report payload is server-rendered from the same BuildInformationReadService snapshot used by /api/build
laravel_adaptation.release_history_rule: no synthetic release history is invented when no authoritative release source exists
laravel_adaptation.wordpress_rule: no WordPress mutation or mock call is invented; this canonical control is read-only and its only side effect is the browser clipboard

authorization_and_tenant_isolation.direct_id_surface: none; the control accepts no caller-supplied resource identifier
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.idor_result: no cross-tenant identifier path is exposed by this control

runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread_equivalence: the server-rendered report payload is asserted field-for-field against BuildInformationReadService::snapshot and /api/build returns that same snapshot
runtime_semantics.idempotency: repeated successful copies only replace the local clipboard with the same authoritative report; duplicate clicks during one in-flight write are suppressed
runtime_semantics.retry_safety: a failed browser clipboard write leaves server/domain state unchanged and can be retried safely
runtime_semantics.audit_or_server_receipt: not applicable because mutation=false and no server/domain state changes; the UI receipt is the browser-confirmed success state

browser_vitest: formats the authoritative build snapshot using the source report contract
reports success only after the browser confirms the clipboard write and blocks duplicate clicks while busy
never emits fake success on clipboard failure and a retry can succeed
fails truthfully when the Clipboard API is unavailable
